rationale: Correctness/resource qualification of three sequential real-browser contexts: interrupted transfer/retry/reconnect, delayed actual completion rejection, and constrained-cache cancellation/eviction. Baseline proves those fault actions; final instrumentation adds explicit context identity and actual browser version without changing the actions. Cumulative work sums per-context sampled maxima; resource peaks remain maxima. Fixed shared budgets match the normal profile. The pressure phase separately asserts 1/4/16 MiB compressed/decoded/GPU bounds in the executable workload. Exactly three total Worker creation events are expected, not three concurrent workers. No recovery latency performance claim; bounded harness deadlines remain enforced. Prior calibration files are retained unchanged and their older attribution limitations remain explicit.
